+@pytest.mark.parametrize('duration, expected_ms', [
+    ('5000', 5000),
+    ('2m30s', 150000),
+    ('0.25m', 15000),
+])
+def test_later_duration(mocker, duration, expected_ms):
+    timer = mocker.patch('qutebrowser.misc.utilcmds.usertypes.Timer').return_value
+    mocker.patch('qutebrowser.misc.utilcmds.runners.CommandRunner')

+
+    utilcmds.later(duration=duration, command='scroll down', win_id=0)
+
+    timer.setInterval.assert_called_once_with(expected_ms)

+
+
+def test_later_invalid_duration(mocker):
+    timer_class = mocker.patch('qutebrowser.misc.utilcmds.usertypes.Timer')

+        utilcmds.later(duration='nonsense', command='scroll down', win_id=0)
+    timer_class.assert_not_called()
